positions.as_written: Expect a cruciate deficient knee to sit and to travel differently rather than only to translate further on testing.
Preserve the posterior horns where possible, on the mechanical ground that they guide the contact path.
Treat rollback as a design requirement rather than a description.
Consider paradoxical motion when a well aligned replacement gives poor deep flexion without pain.
Address slope where it is shifting the contact path rather than treating it as an incidental measurement.
